_README: This file tells the automation HOW TO FIND each NS Retail control.
It is EMPTY ON PURPOSE: NS Retail v4.0.3 has not been inspected yet, and
this project never guesses automation ids, control names or coordinates.
How to fill it in (on the Windows PC, Phase 2):
1. Start NS Retail and log in.
-> copy the main window title into windows.main.title_re
3. Put NS Retail on the screen you want to map, then run:
(click the NS Retail window during the countdown)
4. Copy the printed selector suggestions into the matching step below.
5. Repeat for the Report Viewer and the save dialog.
6. Copy this file to config/selectors.json and check it with:
A target may use any combination of: auto_id, title, title_re,
Actions: invoke (preferred), click, select, expand, set_text, menu_select, wait.
Set "optional": true for a control that is not always present.

steps._comment: Each step is a list of controls to act on, in order.

login.description: Type the credentials and press the login button.

open_reports.description: Open the Reports section of NS Retail.

generate_report.description: Press Report. The Report Viewer window is waited for afterwards.

export_to.description: Open 'Export To' in the Report Viewer.

confirm_export.description: Press OK to confirm the export format.
